investigation.title: Remote Agent Creation Blocked by Swarm Agent Quota Exhaustion (409 Conflict)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-06-15T03:27:25–29Z with an identical 409 Conflict response from POST /api/agents. The swarm backend rejected the agent creation request with the message "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100", meaning the eval probe org has reached its maximum swarm agent count and no new agents can be provisioned until existing ones are deleted or the quota is raised.
investigation.rootCause: The eval probe org has exhausted its swarm agent quota (limit: 100). Every attempt by the observability runner to call POST /api/agents returns HTTP 409 with error code "conflict" and inner message "agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". Because all three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) depend on successfully creating a new agent as their first step, all three fail with the same message before any evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) can be collected. This is an eval infrastructure / probe-account resource exhaustion issue, not a general product outage; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
